_doc: How CAPE call names map onto what CHIMERA's DRAKVUF apimon would record.
CAPE (capemon) logs only the outermost hooked call: measured on 80 WinMET reports, RegSetValueExA -> NtSetValueKey 0%, CreateProcessW -> CreateProcessInternalW 0%, LoadLibraryExW -> LdrLoadDll 5%.
DRAKVUF breaks on every hooked function, so it also sees the inner calls. 'implied' adds the inner hooked call(s) DRAKVUF would see for each outer CAPE call.
'uncertain' lists pairs NOT applied until the bridge set (same samples in both sandboxes) confirms them.

LdrGetProcedureAddressForCaller is deliberately NOT mapped to LdrGetProcedureAddress: GetProcAddress uses the ForCaller path, which CHIMERA's LdrGetProcedureAddress hook does not see (BGInfo on CHIMERA: 2 LdrGetProcedureAddress vs 58 LdrGetDllHandle).
